Whether the genealogical Neri is identical to or related to Jeremiah's contemporary is uncertain. Like many names in Luke's post-exilic list, Neri appears nowhere else in Scripture, underscoring the obscurity through which the Davidic line passed during the centuries of foreign domination. Yet God's purposes run through forgotten generations as surely as through celebrated kings."
